notes: ROUNDING TRAP: 1450.00 x 0.0825 = 119.625 exactly. The invoice shows 119.63, so the scorer requires ROUND_HALF_UP. ROUND_HALF_EVEN yields 119.62 and would falsely fail tax_rate_times_base on a clean document.

DUE DATE TRAP: 'Payable upon receipt.' is a payment term, not a date. The pipeline must NOT infer due_date = invoice_date. Correct label is stated_absent, evidenced by the explicit sentence 'No due date is stated on this invoice.'

PNG input with no text layer, so the text path cannot run. Expected agreement value on every field is single_path, and review severity must still be clean: a missing second opinion is a note, not a flag.
Vendor vs customer: both are US companies with similar formatting. vendor_name is under FROM (Boston, MA), customer under BILL TO (Portland, ME).
Line items carry SKUs in a dedicated Item column; matching should prefer sku exact over description fuzzy match.
